sharedCommandBookmarks.label: AI rules: clip vs memory vs settings
sharedCommandBookmarks.text:
Three ways to influence AI behavior — not interchangeable:

1) AI Clip (Code Spots Commands): copy on click — you decide when the AI sees it.
2) Memory projection (Pro+): selected clips mirrored into AI workspace/repository memory while enabled.
3) Cursor / Copilot user rules: global editor settings — not managed by Code Spots.

Copy-on-click is not automatic enforcement unless memory projection is on for that clip.

sharedCommandBookmarks.label: Onboarding: start here
sharedCommandBookmarks.text:
Welcome — read in this order:

1) README / quickstart
2) Code Spots categories: Entry Points, Core Logic, Configuration
3) concept.* and roadmap for active work
4) Run setup script / install deps before first commit

Ask in team chat if a bookmark is missing — add it to shared.json for the next person.

sharedCommandBookmarks.label: Roadmap: status symbols
sharedCommandBookmarks.comment: Shared #8 — docs root; adopt via wizard if desired
sharedCommandBookmarks.text:
In roadmap, todo, and concept files always use:

✅ implemented
⏳ planned / open
~ evolved beyond original plan
❌ dropped / not relevant

Do not mix other markers — keeps docs readable for humans and AI.

sharedCommandBookmarks.label: Todos: ✅ ❌ + timestamp
sharedCommandBookmarks.comment: Shared #9 — docs root; adopt via wizard if desired
sharedCommandBookmarks.text:
In todo.md and agent replies for this project:

- Open: ⏳ Short description
- Done: ✅ Short description — YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm
- Blocked/dropped: ❌ Short description — reason

Do not delete completed items — add a timestamp.
Prefix new tasks with ⏳.

sharedCommandBookmarks.label: Agent todos: ✅ ❌ in session
sharedCommandBookmarks.comment: Shared — agent todo lists; adopt via wizard if desired
sharedCommandBookmarks.text:
When updating todo lists in this agent session:

- Open tasks: ⏳ description
- Completed: ✅ description — YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm
- Cancelled/blocked: ❌ description — reason

Mark done as soon as a task finishes.
Do not delete completed items — keep ✅ rows with timestamps.
Do not mix other status markers.

sharedCommandBookmarks.label: New feature: write concept first
sharedCommandBookmarks.text:
Plan before implementation:

1) Create concept.<feature>.en.md (problem, goals, non-goals, data model, UX)
2) Add roadmap entry with status ⏳
3) Add concrete tasks to todo.md
4) Implement only after review

Status symbols: ✅ done · ⏳ open · ~ evolved · ❌ dropped

sharedCommandBookmarks.label: Concept → todo.md
sharedCommandBookmarks.text:
After a concept is approved:

1) Extract concrete tasks into todo.md with ⏳ prefix
2) Link each task to the concept section it implements
3) Do not start coding until tasks exist and are reviewed
4) Mark concept roadmap entry ⏳ until all tasks are ✅ or ❌

sharedCommandBookmarks.label: Git: commit when asked
sharedCommandBookmarks.comment: Global personal #10 — copy to global storage
sharedCommandBookmarks.text:
Create git commits only when explicitly requested.

Before committing: git status, diff, recent log — then a concise message focused on why.
Never push unless asked.

sharedCommandBookmarks.label: Code: minimal focused diff
sharedCommandBookmarks.comment: Global personal #16 — copy to global storage
sharedCommandBookmarks.text:
When changing code:

- Smallest correct fix only
- Match existing style and conventions
- No drive-by refactors or unrelated edits
- Reuse existing helpers instead of duplicating logic

sharedCommandBookmarks.label: Git: never delete untracked
sharedCommandBookmarks.text:
Never delete untracked files without explicit approval.

Other workspace roots or teammates may rely on the same checkout.
Ask before running cleanup on unknown files.

sharedCommandBookmarks.label: Before commit: run tests
sharedCommandBookmarks.text:
Before committing or opening a PR:

1) Run the project test command
2) Fix failures in scope of your change
3) Mention what you ran in the PR test plan

sharedCommandBookmarks.label: PR description template
sharedCommandBookmarks.text:
## Summary
- What changed and why (1–3 bullets)

## Test plan
- [ ] …

## Notes
- Breaking changes / migration / screenshots if UI

sharedCommandBookmarks.label: Shared: no secrets
sharedCommandBookmarks.text:
Never store credentials, tokens, or internal URLs with passwords in shared.json or shared AI clips.

Use personal.json, encrypted personal storage, or the Secrets vault instead.
Shared bookmarks may be committed to Git.

sharedCommandBookmarks.label: Bug report prompt
sharedCommandBookmarks.text:
Summarize the bug before proposing a fix:

- Symptom and steps to reproduce
- Expected vs actual behavior
- Relevant files / logs / error messages
- Smallest fix that solves it — ask before changing unrelated code

sharedCommandBookmarks.label: Release policy (team)
sharedCommandBookmarks.text:
Affected repos: every repo in scope that shows changes in git status.

Order:
1) Submodules first — commit, bump version, tag x.y.z
2) Superproject — update submodule pointers + own changes, same steps
3) Companion repos (e.g. *_info) — same steps

Rules:
- One tag x.y.z per repo
- Bump version only when there are real changes
- No empty release commits

sharedCommandBookmarks.label: Agent: safe release run
sharedCommandBookmarks.text:
When executing a release for this workspace:

- Never delete untracked files without asking (other workspaces may use the same repos)
- Include untracked files in commits except obvious junk (.tmp, build artifacts)
- Push only when explicitly requested
- If a repo has no real changes, skip version bump and tag for that repo

sharedCommandBookmarks.label: Release: version if changed
sharedCommandBookmarks.text:
Bump package/version fields only when there are real changes to ship.

Skip version bump and tag when the release would be empty or noise-only.

sharedCommandBookmarks.label: Tags: semver per repo
sharedCommandBookmarks.text:
Use one semver tag format per repository: x.y.z (no mixed v-prefix unless the whole team agreed once).

Tag only after version bump and tests pass.

sharedCommandBookmarks.label: Pre-release checklist
sharedCommandBookmarks.text:
Before tagging a release:

- Unit tests green
- Extension compiles / bundles
- CHANGELOG.md and package.json version aligned
- No internal-only paths in shipped files
- .vscodeignore / package contents reviewed

sharedCommandBookmarks.label: Marketplace release prep
sharedCommandBookmarks.text:
Before marketplace publish:

- CHANGELOG entry for this version
- package.json version matches tag
- README / screenshots current
- .vscodeignore excludes dev-only paths
- Run extension tests and smoke-install VSIX if applicable

sharedCommandBookmarks.label: i18n: update all locales
sharedCommandBookmarks.text:
When changing user-visible strings, update every shipped locale (e.g. en, de, fr, lb).

Do not leave English-only keys in i18n JSON files.
Match existing key naming and tone per locale file.

sharedCommandBookmarks.label: Fix shared.json conflict
sharedCommandBookmarks.text:
When .csvs/shared.json has Git conflict markers:

1) Resolve conflict markers in the file first (do not edit bookmarks in Code Spots on a conflicted file)
2) Run Code Spots: Repair Bookmarks if needed
3) Re-open sidebar and verify categories and clips
4) Commit the resolved JSON
